newsitem.title: UK: UK mulls prosecuting BHP over leak from rig.
newsitem.headline: UK mulls prosecuting BHP over leak from rig.

text.p: The British government may prosecute Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd over the leak of a polluting substance earlier this month from an oil and gas rig off Britain's coast, Environment Minister Michael Meacher said on Tuesday.

"I am certainly very concerned about that and we are .. following that up and considering what actions, including prosecution, does need to be taken," Meacher told MPs during parliamentary question time.

The matter had been raised by Conservative MP Michael Jack, who said "a very noxious substance" had floated over his Fylde, north west England, constituency, causing 300 people to ring their gas supplier to complain of what they believed was a leak.
Jack said in fact the leak was "a sulphurous release" from an oil and gas prospecting rig in Liverpool Bay.

Meacher said the incident was one of two which have occurred in the area recently. He said there was a further problem last Saturday, but that the authorities' efforts to discover where the pollution came from then had come to naught.
"I am very concerned about these incidents. They are very serious," Meacher said.
